description:
## Why

PKIX-ng0x decomposition, child 5 of 5. RFC 5755 §6 specifies the AC
CRL profile. ACs revoke separately from PKCs. The existing
`pkix-revocation::CrlChecker` is PKC-shaped and likely needs an
AC-aware variant (or a parameterised version).

## What

1. Survey pkix-revocation to find the natural extension point — either
   add an AC mode to CrlChecker or add a parallel AcCrlChecker.
2. Implement AC CRL fetching/parsing using the existing pkix-revocation
   infrastructure where possible.
3. The AC CRL is itself an X.509 CRL but with specific extensions per
   RFC 5755 §6 (NoRevocationAvailable indicator, AC-CRL distinguished
   from PKC-CRL).
4. Integrate into `validate_attribute_cert` as an optional revocation
   check, defaulting to `NoRevocation` so existing callers do not
   silently gain a network dep.

## Tests

- [ ] AC CRL parse round-trip against an external oracle.
- [ ] Revoked AC detection on a test vector.
- [ ] NoRevocationAvailable extension causes a documented verdict
      (likely "indeterminate", caller policy decides).

## Depends on

PKIX-ng0x.3 (validation pipeline must exist).
Coordinates with pkix-revocation crate but does not block on
fundamental pkix-revocation changes.
title: pkix-ac: RFC 5755 §6 AC CRL revocation
